gates.py:50-62 `_count_ac_reset`: matches `## acceptance criteria` case-insensitively, resets on next `## `, matches `- [` lines only within the section (the same scoping the new precheck needs).
`_count_ac_reset` counts all `- [` items and does NOT filter `- [ ]` vs `- [x]`, so the unchecked distinction is genuinely new — the concern is duplicated section-scoping, not a full rebuild.
findings.finding: The plan reimplements AC-section parsing without acknowledging the existing authoritative scoping helper `_count_ac_reset` in `src/rebar/_engine_support/gates.py`, which already handles the `## Acceptance Criteria` heading match (case-insensitive) and reset-on-next-`## ` logic that check-ac/clarity rely on.
